beats.say: The SuperKMeans authors fused their dimension-pruning trick with the new 2-epoch e-means algorithm, clustering high-dimensional embeddings for IVF vector indexes much faster without losing quality.
On 5M 1536-d OpenAI embeddings, SuperEMeans took 128 s versus 203 s for e-means, 232 s for SuperKMeans and 985 s for 10-iteration Lloyd's, with the same recall100 as e-means.
The index: We will build an IVF index with a point-per-cluster ratio of 1:256, resulting in approximately 20,000 centroids for OpenAI and 40,000 centroids for the Cohere dataset.
